newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SCA unit forms jv with Japan's Uni-Charm.
newsitem.headline: SCA unit forms jv with Japan's Uni-Charm.

text.p: Swedish paper products group SCA on Thursday said its adult incontinence unit, Molnlycke, had formed a joint venture with Japan's Uni-Charm in which both companies will have a 50/50 stake.
The name of the new company will be Uni-Charm SCA Molnlycke K.K. and its products will be marketed under the name Tena.
SCA said in a statement that the market had a total estimated value of 800 million crowns.
Uni-Charm, which has an annual turnover of about nine billion crown, is the market leader in Japan in nappies and female hygiene products.
